title: Best as decoration only. 16 months and already fraying
text: Best as decoration only. 16 months and already fraying. I bought these last year at the Biltmore Estate in one of the many gift shops on the grounds. The towels are very pretty and soft and for infrequent use or as decorative accents only, they are just fine. But....if you actually want to use them to dry wet hands just get something else. These aren't really absorbent and they aren't all that durable. After 16 months, 2 of the 4 have begun to show thin spots and fraying after coming out of the dryer.

product_metadata.title: Caffco International Biltmore Inspirations Collection Kitchen Towels, Fleur De Lis, Set of 4
features: Set of 4 Fleur De Lis kitchen towels
Four designs in rich black and taupe jacquard, stripe, solid and embroidered waffle weave
Inspired by the Fleur De Lis shapes carved into the limestone columns near the front door of the Biltmore House
description: Update your style with these timeless textiles. Towels come in four coordinating designs. Jacquard patterns, stripes or solid background in rich black and taupe and an antiqued white with a single black fleur de lis emblem on the waffle weave. Each towel in this set of 4 measures 28-Inch long x 18-Inch wide and is made from durable chino cotton. The coordinating jacquard and embroidered napkins offer the perfect finishing touch to this collection and are available separately. The design, chosen for its simplicity and regal presence is inspired by the fleur de lis pattern carved into the limestone columns near the front door of the Biltmore House, a French Renaissance inspired chateau near Asheville, North Carolina, built by George Washington Vanderbilt between 1888 and 1895. It is the largest privately owned home in the United States at 175,000 square feet and featuring 255 rooms. Still owned by Vanderbilt's descendants, it stands today as one of the most prominent remaining examples of the Gilded Age.
